title: AuditLog
description: Immutable audit trail of all admin actions. Source: docs/EDD.md §4.10; docs/SCHEMA.md §2.11 audit_logs. Renamed from legacy admin_audit_log (commit 27e2ab5). Retention: 2 years (admin_audit_log_retention_years).

id.description: BIGSERIAL PK; sequential ordering for log replay.

adminId.description: Actor admin user id. FK to admin_users.id (ON DELETE RESTRICT). NULL for failed-login attempts with unknown username.

targetId.description: UUID or natural key of the affected entity.

detail.description: Action-specific JSONB payload (e.g., flag reason, before/after values for config changes).

ipAddressHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the raw client IP. Raw IP never stored. Retained 90 days (IP_ADDRESS_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS).

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp the log row was inserted (immutable).
